svg.title: How the Rollout brings a release to the repositories
svg.desc: A run of the Release workflow that can have made a release starts the plan. The plan takes the release that the run published and lists the repositories of the release app, the quickest checks first. Then one job for each repository, one at a time: it looks for the blueprint bot, starts it, and waits for the bot and the checks of its update pull request, up to 15 minutes, before the next repository. A repository without a bot is left out; one that GitHub doesn't answer or start, or whose bot fails, fails its job by its name, and the next repository starts all the same.
